## Every payer gets a receipt they can check themselves {#receipts}

<span class="kicker">The proof · released 7 November 2026</span>

<div class="cards">
<div class="card"><h3>Made from the books</h3><p>The books remake it byte for byte, so a later edit shows. No names inside.</p></div>
<div class="card card--green"><h3>Anyone can check</h3><p>A family, CPA or auditor, in a browser. Nothing leaves the page.</p></div>
<div class="card card--ink"><h3>What it catches</h3><p>A changed or deleted payment in a sealed month; a forged receipt. Edits before sealing: <span class="tag tag--next">next</span></p></div>
</div>

<p class="fine">No school issues them yet; the first pilot is next. The format and checker are free for anyone, forever.</p>

::: {.notes}
Sources: `docs/business/business-plan.md` §1 and §3 (signed receipts and sealed months released in tfd 0.10.0, 2026-11-07, milestone 1, justbry/atm #123 and #137; "Not yet issued by any school"); `packages/atm/README.md`, "Receipts and seals (new in 0.10.0)" (an Ed25519 receipt per payment and refund, a pure function of its event; no name or email; `tfd verify receipt`, `tfd verify seals`); `packages/atm/ROADMAP.md`, milestone 1 ("Not live anywhere yet"; known limits: the open month isn't sealed until close; a receipt doesn't prove Stripe moved the money). `docs/business/website-open-questions.md` 4.2 (claim schools issue receipts only once one does). No source says any state program accepts them.

Checker: `packages/verify/README.md` (`tfd-verify`, browsers and other WebCrypto runtimes, "nothing leaves the page"; not published to npm). Licenses (AGENTS.md "Licensing"): the receipt and seal format, spec and verifier are Apache-2.0, the test vectors CC0-1.0; the engine is FSL-1.1-ALv2 from 0.10.0 and each release becomes Apache-2.0 two years after it ships. A self-hosted copy issues self-signed receipts, never "Witnessed by Trifold" (TRADEMARKS.md).

What catches what: `apps/trifold-site/src/content/how-it-works.md`, "What catches what" (a hash chain over every event, milestone 2, catches edits before sealing).
:::
